name: group
expr: [G1, ID1] = findgroups(g); [G2, ID2] = findgroups(g2); [C1, GR1, P1] = groupcounts(g); [C2, GR2] = groupcounts(g2);
comment: findgroups + groupcounts — basic group ID assignment + NaN handling (NaN entries → G=NaN in findgroups; trailing NaN bucket in groupcounts). Extended outputs: groupcounts 2-out returns GR (representative values), 3-out adds P (percentage). MATLAB R2025b convention.
